slovak.tip1: Tip 1: Use flashcards to memorize vocabulary.
slovak.tip2: Tip 2: Practice speaking with native speakers.
slovak.tip3: Tip 3: Watch movies and listen to music in the target language.
slovak.tip4: Hovorím = I say/speak eg hovorím po anglicky
slovak.tip5: Hovoríš = you say eg hovoríš po slovensky
slovak.tip6: Hovoriť = to speak this is the natural one
slovak.tip7: čo si povedal = what did you say
slovak.tip10: Chcel by si íst do posilňovne= would you like to go gym
slovak.tip13: Ja som prišiel domov = i have arrived home
slovak.tip15: Pripravený= ready or in context of getting ready
slovak.trip17: Mohol = could, eg you could ski. Mohli by ste lyžovať
